unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about the individual's person or accessible property when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Applies under any of the following circumstances: (1) inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft; (2) entering or in a sterile area; or (3) attempting to board or onboard a screened aircraft under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.

unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply as to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.scope_text: As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property, if the individual is qualifying law enforcement personnel or an authorized individual under specified provisions or a security program.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Applies if the individual is any of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while performing law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon under §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or 49 CFR part 1562 subpart B; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any loaded firearm(s).
unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any unloaded firearm(s) unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; the firearm is unloaded; the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, for any unloaded firearm(s), unless all four conditions in paragraphs (c)(2)(i) through (iv) are satisfied.
unit_attributes.choice_text: The passenger must declare to the aircraft operator either orally or in writing before checking the baggage.

unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.statement: Section 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm, while Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
